Your route to
permanent residence in Cyprus
acf.s095_p: A qualifying property starts at €300,000 plus VAT and must be bought new from the developer.
acf.s097_p: The application can include you, your spouse, and your dependent children. Besides owning the property, you need to show a secured annual income.
acf.s099_p: You need to visit Cyprus once every 2 years to keep the status.
acf.s100_p: The information on this website is for general reference and may not reflect the latest program requirements or legal rules.
acf.s102_p: Owning a property at Konia Green can lead to permanent residence in Cyprus for you and your family, with the following benefits:
acf.s106_li: You can live, study, and run a business in Cyprus.
acf.s107_li: A high quality of life, with well-developed infrastructure.
acf.s111_li: A modern healthcare system to European standards, free of charge for citizens and permanent residents.
acf.s112_li: A quality education system on the British model, recognized worldwide, at a reasonable cost (lower than comparable international schools in many home countries).
acf.s116_li: An open, transparent business environment with a clear regulatory system.
acf.s117_li: Cyprus has one of the lowest corporate tax rates in Europe, at 12.5%.
acf.s118_li: Favorable tax policy: no tax on worldwide income and no inheritance tax.
acf.s121_p: The physical permanent residence card is renewed every 5 years, provided you still own the property.
acf.s122_h4: Meet the residence and language conditions
acf.s123_p: At least 8 years of physical residence within an 11-year period, Greek language at CEFR level B1, and a pass in the cultural integration test.
acf.s125_p: Dual citizenship is allowed. A Cypriot passport gives visa-free travel to more than 170 destinations.
